pms.thesis: Hold the existing 2027 H/M/U/Z CORRA receive, but do not add. The exact strip has normalized materially in our favor to about 3.22 from the 3.40 entry, yet it still averages roughly 91bp above 2.31 cash and March alone remains around 2.945. Canadian underlying inflation near 1.95% and weak domestic labor still do not validate the full 2027 hike path. Brent near 102 and the LNG Canada expansion are genuine upside risks to Canadian inflation and activity, so the remaining edge is smaller and does not justify adding.

pms.thesis: AUDNZD at 1.2456 is a 99.6 five-year extreme while kiwi is independently cheap versus the dollar at a 3.5 five-year percentile. Shorting the cross is the cleaner kiwi mean-reversion expression: it fades rich Aussie versus cheap kiwi without a naked long in a high-beta commodity currency while Hormuz remains the swing factor. Australian tightening into March is a real headwind and carry is mildly against the short, so the ticket is half the merchant size, short-dated, and cut quickly if the cross extends rather than mean-reverts. Even a half-percent fade covers the official overnight charge on a two-to-three percent adverse path.
